# SDR GROW

> SDR GROW is an outbound operating system for recruitment and staffing agencies. One person runs a dashboard and produces the output of a full SDR desk: sourced decision-maker contacts, drafted outreach, and a 16-touch sequence across email and LinkedIn that books client meetings.

SDR GROW is built for recruitment agencies, boutique recruiters and staffing firms that have outgrown referrals and need repeatable client acquisition without hiring sales development reps.

## What it is

A structured 16-touch outbound system: 8 email touches and 8 LinkedIn touches coordinated over 60 days. Rather than emailing one contact per company, it reaches every layer — CEO to CEO, manager to managers — each from a matching role and address on the sender side. Most positive replies arrive between touch 5 and touch 12, which is why two-touch sequences underperform.

It replaces a stack of disconnected tools: lead data, enrichment, email sending and warming, LinkedIn content, blog and SEO, competitor monitoring.

## The eight modules

- Leads — source, filter and enrich decision-maker contacts
- Email Pipeline — domain warming, inbox management, deliverability
- Outreach Flow — multi-touch sequencing across channels
- LinkedIn Spy — track high-performing content in your niche
- Blog Spy — identify competitor content driving search traffic
- Competitor Mentions — alerts when prospects engage competitors
- Industry Insight — trending topics for timely outreach
- Brand Voice — tone alignment across every message

## Pricing

- 7-day free trial: full access, no credit card required
- Setup: $1,997 one-time
- Monthly: $1,200
- Optional VA add-on: $2,000/month for hands-off execution
- Recommended minimum run: 90 days, so domains warm and messaging compounds
- Setup time: days, not months

## Cost comparison

Running the same functions manually requires roughly three hires (SDR ~$4,500, lead researcher ~$3,500, content ~$4,000) plus six tools (lead data, enrichment, email warming, LinkedIn content, SEO, competitor monitoring), totalling approximately $17,400/month at list prices. SDR GROW covers the same scope for $1,200/month plus setup, operated by one existing person. A single in-house SDR costs $4,000-$6,000/month before tools and takes 3-6 months to ramp.

## Expected performance

Target reply rates of 8-15% for tightly targeted multi-channel outbound, against a 1-2% baseline for generic single-channel campaigns. Actual results depend on niche, list quality and offer. Sending capacity is 5,000+ emails per month with proper domain warming.

## Who it is for

- Recruitment agencies doing consistent placements, ready for structured growth
- Boutique recruiters who have outgrown referrals
- Staffing firms wanting predictable client acquisition
- Teams tired of inconsistent outbound and disconnected tooling
